name: Flutterwave

webhook.algorithm: PARTIALLY VERIFIED, and version-dependent — this is a trap. v3: header `verif-hash` containing the merchant's dashboard secret hash IN PLAINTEXT. That is a shared-secret echo, NOT a signature: it does not bind the payload, so a leaked hash forges any event. v4: header `flutterwave-signature`, HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed with the dashboard secret hash, hex. No timestamp in either version (the v4 payload carries a separate `timestamp` field that is NOT covered by the signature). Generator must branch on API version and must flag the v3 path as an anti-pattern.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. v3 keys are `FLWSECK_TEST-...`/`FLWSECK-...` (secret), `FLWPUBK_TEST-...`/`FLWPUBK-...` (public), plus an encryption key — exact suffix charset UNKNOWN. v4 replaces static keys with OAuth2 client_credentials against http

fees.notes: UNKNOWN with confidence. Commonly cited as 1.4% local / 3.8% international in Nigeria, but Flutterwave publishes per-country schedules that diverge and are frequently renegotiated. Do not hardcode a number; store per-country or leave null.

notes: Single integration reaching ~30 African markets and, critically, the mobile-money wallets (M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel) without negotiating separately with each telco. For any merchant selling into more than two African countries this is the highest-leverage single provider in the cluster.

SDKs: First-party: `flutterwave-node-v3` (npm), `rave_python` (PyPI), `flutterwavedev/flutterwave-v3` (Composer). All are v3-era; v4 has no mature first-party server SDK as of mid-2026, so v4 codegen should be direct REST + OAuth token cache.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Paystack in NG/GH/KE/ZA/CI; overlaps Onafriq and the direct telco APIs for mobile money — and beats both on integration cost.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
